name: Forno Acqua MultiSINK Stainless Steel 22" Dual Mount 3-Level Workstation Sink with Waterfall Faucet and Glass Rinser
shortDescription: Reimagine your kitchen with the MultiSINK Pro T-Faucet Workstation a sculpted centerpiece designed for beauty, versatility, and performance. Its 3-level layout and 10" deep basin create seamless zones for prep, rinse, and cleanup. The stainless steel T waterfall faucet offers three spray modes for pro-level control, while the integrated glass washer keeps drinkware spotless. A dual-function bamboo cutting board, stainless steel colander, and four roll-up grids adapt to your workflow, while two removable drying grilles add utility to the deck without clutter. With dual-mount flexibility, cUPC certification, and precision-crafted details, MultiSINK brings timeless design to the heart of your kitchen.
